proposeImport.effect: Validates through the normal import path and opens the visible proposal without changing the project.

applyImportProposal.effect: Applies only the current fingerprint-matched proposal through the normal merge path.

discardImportProposal.effect: Closes and discards the current proposal without changing the project.

import: Wait for the filechooser before activating the real file input.
Set one project, one workspace, or both absolute paths in any order.
Inspect the proposal dialog and choose configuration/layout/pins.
Click Apply proposal or leave the proposal open for human review.
agentImport: Read one project JSON string and optionally one workspace JSON string with a terminal/filesystem tool.
Inspect the returned summary and the visible proposal.
When authorized, call applyImportProposal with the exact returned fingerprint and three explicit boolean choices; otherwise leave it open or discard it.
export: Stop the simulation using the real button when exact current positions are required.
Write the returned string with a filesystem tool using private permissions; clipboard and browser downloads are not required.
humanLoop: Leave the graph open for manual placement and pins.
After the user says they are done, re-read status, fingerprint, revision, and dirty state.
Stop the simulation, read getWorkspaceJson(), store it, then propose and apply it again to verify an exact round trip.
